'''Koam''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Republic trooper]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Army]] who was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
